references.title: DPLL with Caching: A New Algorithm for #SAT and Bayesian Inference
references.source: Electronic Colloquium on Computational Complexity, TR03-003
references.note: Primary algorithmic source showing how residual/component memoization converts backtracking into dynamic programming and can yield exponential savings when identical subproblems recur; it does not establish polynomial-time SAT.

references.title: Formula Caching in DPLL
references.source: Electronic Colloquium on Computational Complexity, TR06-140
references.note: Primary proof-complexity source distinguishing exact/basic Formula Caching from reason-caching and ordinary Resolution. The reason-plus-weakening system polynomially simulates regular Resolution and can have short proofs where Resolution is exponential.

references.title: An Improved Separation of Regular Resolution from Pool Resolution and Clause Learning
references.note: Primary source proving polynomial pool-resolution and greedy unit-propagating clause-learning refutations for graph-tautology principles. Thus graph tautologies can attack basic exact caching but cannot lower-bound a successful reason-learning upgrade without further restrictions.

references.title: Resolution Trees with Lemmas: Resolution Refinements that Characterize DLL Algorithms with Clause Learning
references.note: Primary source characterizing unit-propagation clause learning by regular WRTI and general learning by regular WRTL, clarifying the proof-system target that a context-independent JANUS reason rule could approach.

references.title: Towards Understanding and Harnessing the Potential of Clause Learning
references.note: Primary source characterizing clause learning as a proof system and showing a restart-enabled variant as powerful as general Resolution. This marks a substantially stronger resource than Policy-0A's exact Boolean cache.
